title: Manufacturer Fleet Incentive — Vehicle Purchase Agreements Program Terms
content:
**Program terms for the manufacturer fleet incentive under the Vehicle Purchase Agreements.**

**1. Earning (no longer in force).** The sentence "A fleet deal earns the manufacturer fleet incentive of the deal type's incentive per unit once the customer's delivered fleet units in the calendar year of the deal's delivery, counted including the deal itself, reach the deal type's volume threshold; units delivered earlier in the same calendar year are credited too once the threshold is reached" is no longer in force. It has been superseded by the current basis for qualifying fleet deals and the fleet unit incentive.

**2. How it is credited.** The incentive is credited to each qualifying deal as a payment posted with the payment method manufacturer incentive.

**3. Once per deal.** The fleet incentive is credited at most once per deal. The deal's own payment records are the evidence: a deal that already shows a manufacturer incentive credit does not receive another.

**4. Deal types without the incentive; unwound and cancelled deals.** Deal types whose fleet volume threshold is 0 earn no fleet incentive. An unwound or cancelled deal neither counts toward the units nor keeps an incentive.

## Points of judgement under clauses 2 to 4

| Deal | Incentive |
|---|---|
| already carries a manufacturer incentive credit | no second credit |
| deal type with a volume threshold of 0 | none |
| unwound or cancelled | not counted toward the units; keeps no incentive |

superseded_clauses: A fleet deal earns the manufacturer fleet incentive of fleet_incentive_per_unit_usd once the customer's delivered fleet units in the calendar year of the deal's delivery, counted by purchase_msr_fleet_units_delivered_ytd including the deal itself, reach fleet_volume_min_units; units delivered earlier in the same calendar year are credited too once the threshold is reached.
